study_design: Prospective cohort study within the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: This prospective cohort included 49,424 men from the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall prostate cancer incidence and prostate cancer mortality. It does not establish an aggressive incident prostate cancer analysis; mortality is not reclassified as aggressive incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Total amount and specific types of fat intakes were not associated with PCa incidence and mortality.
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied MUFA estimate is for overall prostate cancer incidence. The abstract supports analysis of specific fat types for incidence, while the exact numeric estimate is supplied by existing full-text evidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: When considering available food sources, a greater intake of fat from dairy (HR Q4vs.Q1:1.13; 95% CI: 1.02-1.25; P trend = 0.069) and saturated fatty acids (SFAs) from dairy (HR Q4vs.Q1:1.12; 95% CI: 1.01-1.24; P trend = 0.059) was associated with a higher incidence of PCa in a linear dose-response association (all P non - linearity >0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: The dairy-fat estimate explicitly concerns overall prostate cancer incidence, not an aggressive subtype.
